acceptance_criteria.criterion: The check runs on every build (both real builds and --check runs)
A template using {{agent_slug_foo_bar}} without foo-bar in subagents produces an error
A persona with no agent_slug_* references and no subagents field passes silently
The error message identifies the persona, the template variable, and the expected subagents entry

summary: Added a post-build cross-reference validation block to scripts/build-personas.js that runs unconditionally (both real builds and --check mode).

The block scans each ledger persona content file (personas/ledger/src/content/*.md) for {{agent_slug_X_Y}} references, converts the suffix to kebab-case slug (X_Y → x-y), and verifies the slug exists in the persona's subagents list in its YAML metadata.
Error messages identify the persona base name, the exact template variable, the expected slug, and the YAML file to fix.
Personas with no {{agent_slug_*}} references and no subagents field pass silently with no output.
Added a local extractSubagentsList() helper that correctly parses flat block YAML lists with inline comment stripping and quote stripping.
node scripts/build-personas.js --check exits 0 for the current clean workspace.

comments.note: The extractSubagentsList function in build-personas.js is a local re-implementation of the same logic as _extract_yaml_list in orchestrator/src/utils/persona_models.py. If more YAML parsing is needed in future scripts, a shared JS utility (e.g. scripts/lib/yaml-utils.js) would consolidate these two implementations.

The validation only scans personas/ledger/src/content/*.md files. If {{agent_slug_*}} references are ever added to shared partials (personas/ledger/src/partials/), they will not be caught. Extending the scan to partials would require resolving which persona a partial belongs to, which adds complexity not warranted by current usage.

No formal test harness for build-personas.js. The --check flag provides an integration-level check but there are no unit tests for the extractSubagentsList or cross-reference logic. Consider adding a test script under scripts/tests/ if the script grows further.

summary: All 4 acceptance criteria verified for the agent_slug cross-reference validation in build-personas.js.
AC1: Validation block at line 176 of scripts/build-personas.js is a bare IIFE block (no CHECK condition) — runs unconditionally on every invocation, confirmed by code structure inspection.
AC2: Injecting {{agent_slug_nonexistent_bad_agent}} into the PM content file and running --check exits with code 1 and [ERROR] output.
AC3: Clean --check run processes 84 personas with exit 0 and no error output — all non-PM personas (which have no agent_slug refs) pass silently.

Add "nonexistent-bad-agent" to the subagents field in 2-project-manager.yaml.' — identifies persona, variable, slug, and YAML file.

comments.note: The {{agent_slug_*}} regex pattern is /\{\{agent_slug_([a-z0-9_]+)\}\}/g — only matches all-lowercase suffixes. This is intentional and correct (enforces the kebab-case convention), but a brief comment on the regex explaining the lowercase-only constraint would help future maintainers who might wonder why mixed-case references are not caught.
